NEXT_ECONOMIC_GATE.question: can a second economic research campaign start? Not yet. The runtime is ready to size and bound a futures position; it has nothing with a measured edge to size, and it cannot place orders by construction.
required_before_campaign_2: a strategy hypothesis with a PIT-measured edge (the RFC-046 campaign failed and no candidate is admitted; RFC-048 explicitly does not create one)
a measured futures cost model verified against a real account schedule (fees are currently a published assumption, spread/impact measured once)
jurisdiction/venue eligibility verified for the operator (BLK-048-02: still PRODUCT_ELIGIBILITY_UNKNOWN)
partial-liquidation rules obtained in verifiable form (BLK-048-03: refused rather than modelled)
cross-margin dependencies validated before any cross usage (BLK-048-04)
a binding futures review path plus admission-ledger integration if futures PAPER is ever to place simulated orders (today the review is advisory and no order is authorised)
NEXT_ECONOMIC_GATE.not_included: opening that campaign, changing governance flags, or treating an engineering pass as economic evidence

CONCLUSION: Offline certification of the supported contracts. It means the risk arithmetic, the refusals and the runtime boundary survived independent rebuilding and adversarial search. It does not mean profitability, eligibility or production readiness.
